# ČS Dating Wien

> ČS Dating Wien is Vienna's curated speed dating event for people with Slovak and Czech roots, plus community evenings. The next event is Edition II, which takes place on Monday, 12 October 2026, 19:30–21:30 at a mystery venue in Vienna (exact location announced 48 hours before to confirmed guests). 16 spots (8 men, 8 women), ages 30–45. Entry: €69, reduced to €39 with code EDITION2 until 31 August 2026. A community Quiz Night was held earlier, on Saturday 8 August 2026, with 13 guests; it is over. Organizer: Jakub Popluhar, M.Ed., based in Vienna.

## About

ČS Dating Wien brings together people with Slovak and Czech roots in Vienna for in-person, curated evenings. The speed-dating format runs several short rounds; matches are arranged privately after the event. Events are conducted in Slovak and Czech. No German or English required.

The project addresses a gap in Vienna's dating scene: People with Slovak and Czech roots in Vienna (tens of thousands of people) have no dedicated venue for meeting partners and friends who share their language and cultural background. Edition I (22 June 2026) was successfully completed with 11 guests and strong participant feedback (average rating 5.0/5). A community Quiz Night followed on 8 August 2026 with 13 guests.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What language are the events in?
A: Slovak and Czech. The MC alternates both languages. No German required.

Q: Who can attend the speed dating?
A: People with Slovak and Czech roots living in Vienna, ages 30–45, seriously looking for a relationship. Born in Bratislava, Brno, or Vienna — it does not matter as long as you share the language and culture.

Q: Is there a refund policy?
A: Speed dating: full refund within 72 hours if the application does not match criteria. Other cancellation rules: see csdating.eu/terms/.

Q: How does matching work (speed dating)?
A: After the event, attendees submit a match form. If interest is mutual, contacts are exchanged privately between the two people only.
